question: Can an eligible direct semantic geometry change a normalized cross-type static-price ratio when more than one non-anchor type is present?
scope: Synthetic profile-only composition; no board, search, game, or utility run.

arms.control: Same type list and all other RuleSet fields; semantic action omitted so R uses its four declared orthogonal rays.
arms.candidate: Same synthetic type list; existing compound semantic action is compiled and eligible R direct geometry is unioned into the static projection.

interpretation: One controlled composition establishes sensitivity of the median-normalized relative input, not utility, robustness, generated-domain generality, search behavior, or a recommended price.
